categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Lihexing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: intelligent manufacturing equipment and electronic components manufacturing. The intelligent manufacturing equipment segment focuses on R&D, production, and sales of automated and intelligent devices mainly for mobile smart terminals, new energy vehicles, servers, digital energy, and OLED flexible displays. The electronic components segment, managed by its subsidiary Lihexing Electronics, specializes in the development, production, and sales of multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) and related electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including industrial robotics, automatic control, machine vision, artificial intelligence, information communication, and precision machinery to develop intelligent manufacturing equipment. Production methods include customized design and manufacturing processes such as mechanical processing, sheet metal processing, structural assembly, electrical assembly, software programming, and debugging. For electronic components, the company employs IATF16949-compliant APQP processes, with production involving material preparation, layering, lamination, cutting, firing, testing, and packaging, focusing on high-frequency, high-capacity, and automotive-grade MLCC products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading ICT companies such as Huawei, Honor, ZTE, BYD, Visionox, Inspur, and New Kai Lai. The company serves industries including mobile smart terminals, new energy vehicles, digital energy, servers, OLED flexible displays, and electronic components for communication devices, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial control, and AI hardware. The electronic components segment targets markets requiring high reliability and performance, such as automotive ECU modules and wireless communication devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant business concentrated in South China (accounting for about 76% of revenue), East China, Central China, and other regions. It also plans to expand internationally, particularly targeting the Japanese market for its electronic components business. The company has subsidiaries and production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Suzhou, Jiangmen, Chengdu, and other Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Lihexing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of intelligent manufacturing equipment and electronic components. It provides customized equipment and components that support downstream manufacturers in ICT, automotive, and other industries, enabling automation and quality testing in production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on intelligent manufacturing solutions and high-value electronic components. Strategic priorities include advancing 'Artificial Intelligence+' initiatives, accelerating domestic substitution of imported technologies, expanding into international markets (notably Japan), and enhancing product quality and innovation. R&D projects target high-performance MLCCs, automated testing equipment for new energy vehicles, liquid cooling server technologies, and precision assembly technologies for flexible and curved displays.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment, specialized components, and electronic components (MLCCs). The company also earns income from technical services related to equipment installation, debugging, and upgrades. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales channels, supplemented by some distribution for electronic components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While the company is relatively small compared to peers in the intelligent manufacturing and electronic components sectors, it holds a leading position in certain niche areas such as RF testing, flexible OLED screen lamination, and automotive-grade MLCC testing equipment. It competes by leveraging strong technical capabilities, customized solutions, and close partnerships with major ICT and automotive clients. The company aims to strengthen its market position by focusing on high-value product differentiation and expanding its international footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 577 million, representing a 22.81% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.08 million, a significant turnaround from losses in prior years. The intelligent manufacturing equipment segment accounted for about 74% of revenue, while electronic components contributed about 26%, with the latter growing rapidly by 139%. The company maintains a stable asset base of over RMB 1.5 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures representing over 8% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Lihexing differentiates itself through its rich technical expertise, rapid technology transfer capabilities, and customized intelligent manufacturing solutions that enhance automation, digitalization, and product quality for clients. Its MLCC products emphasize high reliability, high frequency, and automotive-grade standards, targeting high-value applications. The company also prides itself on strong customer relationships with leading ICT and automotive firms, a comprehensive quality management system, and robust after-sales service, which collectively enhance customer satisfaction and brand reputation.
